title: 0235's use brew remedy writes brew install devbin with no Linux route, so installhints.bats is red on CI and the 0.1.15 cut is blocked
body:
## Problem

CI run 40331608642 on f06bad4a, the head that lands 0235, is red on one arm: tests/unit/installhints.bats:107 ("every install hint in the vendored set that names Homebrew also names a Linux route that puts the tool on PATH"). Its FAILURE line names lib/cmd/use:124, the remedy 0235 added for `use brew` when no Homebrew devbin is installed:

    fix="install devbin with Homebrew (brew install devbin), with HOMEBREW_PREFIX exported as brew shellenv exports it"

It writes `brew install devbin` with no Linux route, which the scan refuses, and the short name is the one 0203 took out of the README (Homebrew refuses a short name from a tap it does not trust). tests/unit/use.bats:144 asserts the same text. land235's plan did not run installhints.bats, so the red was first seen on CI. It blocks the 0.1.15 cut.

## Fix

Drop the parenthetical so the remedy reads as devbin's other remedies do (lib/cmd/use:68, lib/install:110): "install devbin with Homebrew, with HOMEBREW_PREFIX exported as brew shellenv exports it". Change use.bats:144 to match.

## Done when

- lib/cmd/use names no `brew install` in any hint; use.bats's 0235 arm asserts the new text.
- Red on main: CI run 40331608642 is main's red (installhints.bats:107), cited, not re-run.
- Green at the fix under BSD and GNU: use.bats, installhints.bats, every tree-scan file and help.bats.
- Landed and pushed by vc; CI green on the new head, which is 0.1.15's cut green.

## Resolution

Fixed at a81f0f98, built and landed by vc from a scratch clone (0a690811 on f06bad4a). lib/cmd/use's remedy for `use brew` when no Homebrew devbin is installed now reads "install devbin with Homebrew, with HOMEBREW_PREFIX exported as brew shellenv exports it", as devbin's other remedies word it (lib/cmd/use:68, lib/install:110), and tests/unit/use.bats's 0235 arm asserts that text. 0.1.15's release note is unchanged, since this corrects 0235 before any release carried it.

- **Done when 1.** lib/cmd/use names no `brew install` in any hint, and use.bats's 0235 arm asserts the new text.
- **Done when 2.** Main's red is CI run 40331608642 on f06bad4a, the head that landed 0235: Test on Ubuntu failed at tests/unit/installhints.bats:107 alone, its FAILURE line naming lib/cmd/use:124. Cited, not re-run.
- **Done when 3.** At the fix, each file alone, under BSD and then GNU: use.bats, installhints.bats, help.bats and every file that scans the tree, found by searching tests/unit for the scan helpers rather than from a list (readonlygit, workroom, documentation, neutral, helpers, contract, harness, vendoredmd, config, dispatch, install, lineendings, releasecut, updatenotice). Every TAP ran to its plan with nothing failed, and the only skips were harness.bats's `require_command` arms and install.bats's case-sensitive-disk arm, which skip by design on this Mac. The runs went one at a time in light slot 01M5WB6685VMP21VX6M9NNZA5Q, from 2026-10-26 14:53:37Z to 15:26:09Z, the driver ending with rc 0 (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/st0010/land236).
- **Done when 4.** Landed and pushed by vc, f06bad4a..a81f0f98 at 15:26:42Z. CI run 40349359447 on a81f0f98 is green: Test on Ubuntu, Shell Script Analysis and Test Summary passed, both plans ran in full with no failing test, and its skips are the same as those of run 40302760947, the last green before 0235. It is the green 0.1.15's cut read at pre-flight.
